text: In December 1968, the Customs Department seized and confiscated a posted copy of Gore Vidal's Myra Breckinridge under Section 4A of the Customs Act. The novel was banned in Australia from 1968 to 1973. Vidal’s biographer Fred Kaplan said that a court case in Australia concerning the book resulted in a ruling that allowed Australian readers to determine what books they would read.
